subject: planner: stop pushing TopN down through Projection if it has undeterministic functions (#53362)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (single-parent commit). Change in `LogicalProjection.PushDownTopN` now aborts TopN pushdown when ORDER BY expressions become non-immutable after column substitution (e.g. `rand()`), avoiding double-evaluation mismatching TopN’s sort key vs Projection output. Added integration test (`TestIssue37986`) asserts both sorted results and `EXPLAIN` shape (TopN stays above Projection). Checked upstream/master: logic is still present (moved files), no later fix needed for this change.
